reference.title: Using a certificate with incomplete chain in Services
reference.shortdesc: The procedure to use a certificate with an incomplete cert chain is the same as the existing procedure to use a complete cert chain.

section.p: Select the desired certificate from the drop-down menu in the service that you are configuring and, if needed, enter the password.

After selecting a certificate, you can notice two main differences:
The certificate will work.
Services that include a Server Certificate Health property (for example, Fox Service and Web Service) have an additional certificate health status: Ok Incomplete Chain.Fox Service's certificate health propertyWeb Service's certificate health property
